wkg@0.16.0 is out now!
https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-pkg-tools/releases/tag/v0.16.0

This includes:

  • intial wkg workspace support
  • multi package publish (works with workspaces as well: wkg publish --workspace)
  • semver validation on publish
  • wkg publish --dry-run
  • updated docs
  • per registry authentication envvars
  • and more!

Still more to do but huge shoutout to @Victor Adossi and @Ryan P for their contributions/help!

Just updated effortlessly!

I recently started integrating the tooling with the Java ecosystem, and this is the repo I'm working on:
https://github.com/andreaTP/inlay

I'm reusing as much as I can directly from wkg(compiled to Wasm, running in Java thanks to Endive), but I'll be more than happy to receive review/feedback on those initial steps:

  • is the approach sound enough?
  • does it play well enough with the rest of the ecosystem?

Happy to hear thoughts!
